reason: The only available action connects the cylinders to the processor's carbon-dioxide outlet, matching the collection goal.
expectation: I expect the cylinders to collect carbon dioxide for the fuel plant, though the details aren't clear yet.

effect: The cylinder collected carbon dioxide upstream of the oxygen-making cell without interrupting the breathing supply, completing the chapter's goal.
reaction: The link between the existing oxygen processor and methane production was satisfying, though the action itself was automatic.

mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting carbon dioxide was worthwhile because it connected an existing life-support system to the return-fuel plan.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter offered only one compatible action, so there was little decision-making.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the carbon dioxide to be taken off before the oxygen-making cell while the breathing line continued running.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: connecting a cylinder to the named outlet had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the collected gases become return propellant, although I hope for more meaningful choices.
